facts.P1_fx_receipts: Exporters must repatriate proceeds within 120–180 days; sources conflict.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Reportedly yes; accounts abroad need only notification.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local providers like Payme, Click and Uzum weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: Register as an individual entrepreneur online via my.gov.uz, about two days.
facts.L2_tax_id: PINFL for individuals; entrepreneurs use the STIR taxpayer number.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Flat 12% income tax; turnover tax available, and exports aren't 0% since 2025.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 12% VAT; turnover-tax payers are outside VAT.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law ZRU-547 on Personal Data, in force since 2019.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L7_incentives: IT Park gives tax exemptions; whether individuals qualify is unclear.

watch_out.text: Export income is taxed under turnover tax since January 2025.
